craft_notes: Sthāyin: channel-verse (middle+nāḍī). Sanskrit: madhyanāḍī madhyasaṃsthā bisasūtrābharūpayā...devaḥ prakāśate → L4 keeps simile + god-through. Rows: row 3 (by-her god-through). Close: through (light as passage). Rejected: 'sahasrāra' — killed: sky kept; 'fiber' alone — lotus-fiber kept (simile intact).

lines: by meditated inner sky, Goddess — god shines through.
l4.sanskrit_cite: madhyanāḍī madhyasaṃsthā bisasūtrābharūpayā | dhyātāntarvyomayā devyā tayā devaḥ prakāśate

reads_against.argmap: What shines through the middle channel? → God shines through the meditated inner sky of the middle channel.
c1_essence: Lotus-fiber middle channel: god shines through meditated sky.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness with piercing resolve)
